lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: a top-down unboxing and flip-through filmed on a table with a phone, followed by one real reaction clip, is enough; add a photo beside the illustration and a price or link, which this Reel lacks.
solo_without_child: yes: the whole first 20 seconds are hands and book only; the reaction shot at the end needs children or relatives
not_verified: Exact book price and page count; whether the creator is a parent or aunt only; whether the children are her nieces; music; the family's real appearance relative to the illustrations.
